exposure: cardiopulmonary resuscitation with cardiac massage and medication administration
cohort: 82 infants in their first year of life (51 males, 31 females) who experienced severe birth asphyxia and underwent therapeutic hypothermia (systemic hypothermia utilizing simple cooling methods) between 2020 and 2023.
finding: The incidence of auditory impairment after therapeutic hypothermia with simple cooling methods did not significantly vary from other studies, and key risk factors for hearing dysfunction included severity of birth asphyxia, postnatal clinical compromise, cerebral tissue injury, and postnatal infectious complications.
mod_finding: A significantly elevated incidence rate of cesarean delivery requirement was observed in infants with SNHL.
followup_time: Within the first year of life
